verdict.rationale: Zero calls itself an AI email solution, and the founder says users can chat with their inbox and have it draft replies, summarize threads and auto-categorize mail. That is a built-in assistant, but its scope for delegated actions inside the app is evidenced mainly by that one community statement. The MCP docs list AI-assisted composing and mailbox Q&A, but as tools exposed to external agents rather than an in-app assistant. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the in-app assistant and which tasks it can execute (e.g., bulk actions or labeling on command), plus hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
